notes:
SCAN DESIGN: extensibility.test.ts walks web/src recursively via node:fs (readdirSync/statSync/readFileSync), collecting non-test .ts/.tsx files (excludes *.test.*, *.spec.* via regex on the filename; excludes .json so locale FILENAMES don't self-flag; content-only match). For each collected file NOT in the whitelist, it substring-searches for the five FLAGGED_CODES (= SUPPORTED_LOCALES minus 'cs-CZ') and asserts zero offenders. FLAGGED_CODES is derived from the registry, not restated. 'cs-CZ' is DELIBERATELY EXEMPT (documented in a long source comment): per the spec formatting non-goal (§21), money stays Kč/cs-CZ and dates Europe/Prague in every UI language, so 'cs-CZ' is a spec-mandated formatting literal in ~30 non-test files (money.ts, TrackingPage, AuditPage, ...) — flagging it would make the scan unsatisfiable.

WHITELIST — the WI named {locales.ts, index.ts, resolveInitialLanguage.ts, shared/date/analyticsRange.ts} (four). I added a FIFTH: shared/i18n/sentinelKeys.ts. DEVIATION RATIONALE (advisor-confirmed): sentinelKeys.ts's ENFORCED_LOCALES array holds ['ru-RU','uk-UA','fil-PH','de-DE'] — four of the five flagged codes — because WI-3..6 each appended their code (per WI-1's design where ENFORCED_LOCALES is seeded empty then populated one code per language WI). The WI-8 whitelist was drafted before ENFORCED_LOCALES was populated from empty, so the designer did not anticipate the codes landing there. sentinelKeys.ts is the same CATEGORY as locales.ts/index.ts: a hand-maintained locale registry that enumerates codes by design. AC#8's registry-derivation requirement names exactly three consumers that must iterate the registry (selector, parity, detection) — NOT sentinel, which is orthogonal (a 7th locale is SUPPORTED with 3 edits; ENFORCING its translation-actuality is a separate optional step). Deriving ENFORCED_LOCALES to avoid whitelisting it would touch WI-1..6 infrastructure and risk the sentinel gate — out of scope for an S docs WI. Per the ambiguity rule I noted it and proceeded rather than burning an AskUserQuestion. Whitelisted the file with an explanatory source comment mirroring the cs-CZ/analyticsRange rationale.

WHITELIST VERIFICATION (grep, non-test .ts/.tsx): en-US -> {analyticsRange.ts, index.ts, locales.ts, resolveInitialLanguage.ts}; ru-RU -> {index.ts, locales.ts, sentinelKeys.ts}; uk-UA -> {index.ts, locales.ts, sentinelKeys.ts}; fil-PH -> {index.ts, locales.ts, resolveInitialLanguage.ts, sentinelKeys.ts}; de-DE -> {index.ts, locales.ts, resolveInitialLanguage.ts, sentinelKeys.ts}. Every hit is inside a whitelisted file; the contract holds end-to-end. (resolveInitialLanguage.ts hits are the tl->fil-PH alias plus JSDoc examples mentioning de-DE/en-US.)
